units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 3:7:2">Y. Gitt. III, 45ᵃ</cite> <he>ויש מ׳ לעני</he> has the poor man a friend?, i.e., is he who separates the poor man’s tithes permitted to reserve them for a certain person?—Pl. <he>מַכָּרִים</he>, constr. <he>מַכָּרֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>במ׳ כהונה וכ׳</he> the Mishnah speaks of friends of priests or Levites (to whom the owner is in the habit of giving the priestly shares); Bab.
<cite ref="Gittin 30a:10">Ib.</cite> <he>במ׳ לא קתני</he> (sub. <cite ref="K00152"><he>כהונה</he></cite>) the Mishnah does not distinctly speak of friends.
